name: chatgpt-chat-exporter
description: Export ChatGPT and Google Gemini conversations to Markdown, HTML, or PDF-ready files from the browser console or as userscripts.

scripts.build: node scripts/build-exporters.js && node scripts/build-bookmarklets.js && node scripts/build-firefox.js
scripts.release:prepare: npm run build && npm test && node scripts/package-release.js
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox-extension --artifacts-dir dist/firefox-unsigned --overwrite-dest
scripts.sign:firefox: npm run build:firefox && web-ext sign --source-dir dist/firefox-extension --artifacts-dir dist/firefox-signed --channel unlisted
